purpose: The purpose of Form MGT-7 is for every company, except One Person Company and Small Company, to file its annual return. One Person Company and Small Company file in Form No. MGT-7A from the financial year 2020-2021 onwards.
who: Every company except One Person Company and Small Company
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Determine if the company is required to file Form MGT-7 instead of Form MGT-7A.
Prepare the annual return details as required for the company.

If the company is a listed company or has a paid-up share capital of ten crore rupees or more or turnover of fifty crore rupees or more, have the annual return certified by a Company Secretary in practice using Form No. MGT.8.
Submit or file the annual return.
checklist: Check if the company is an OPC or Small Company to decide between Form MGT-7 and Form MGT-7A.
Check if the company is a listed company.
Check if the company has a paid-up share capital of ten crore rupees or more.
Check if the company has a turnover of fifty crore rupees or more.
Ensure Form MGT.8 certification is obtained if the company meets the listing, capital, or turnover thresholds.
watch: Form MGT-7 cannot be used by One Person Companies and Small Companies for financial years 2020-2021 onwards, as they must use Form MGT-7A.
